text:
ITEM 1 | Flattened, irregular piece of breaded or battered meat with orange-tan crust, bumpy coated surface, moderate sheen, some darker browned edges and flaky crumbs, spread across roughly 35% of the plate in a mass about 12 cm wide and 1.5 cm thick, sitting on a bed of green leaves | 180
ITEM 2 | Whole small cherry tomatoes, bright red, glossy and smooth-skinned, about 1.5-2.5 cm diameter, six to seven pieces clustered in an arc at the upper right of the meat, slightly soft and juicy-looking | 90
ITEM 3 | Two or three small roasted potato-like chunks, golden-brown with darker crisp patches, matte to slightly oily surface, roughly 2.5-3 cm across and 2 cm high, placed at the lower right edge of the meat | 80
ITEM 4 | Diced fresh tomato pieces, bright red with visible seeds, small cubes about 0.5-1 cm, scattered in a small pile at the left edge of the meat, moist and juicy | 15
ITEM 5 | Scattered green leaves, dark green with lighter veins, flat and limp, a few small pieces tucked under and beside the meat and tomatoes | 10
ITEM 6 | Small crumbs of golden-brown breading or crust scattered on the plate at the upper right and right edge, dry and crumbly | 5
